newsitem.title: USA: Morgan Products to acquire Wahlfeld.
newsitem.headline: Morgan Products to acquire Wahlfeld.

text.p: Morgan Products Ltd said on Wednesday it has entered a tentative agreement to acquire Wahlfeld Manufacturing Co, a distributor of Andersen products and other millwork products.
Wahlfeld is based in Peoria, Ill., and has annual sales of approximately $23 million.
The acquisition, which is subject to a definitive agreement, is expected to close during July, Morgan said.

"With this acquisition, we believe that Morgan Distribution remains on track in achieving its targeted growth objectives," Morgan Products president and chief executive Larry Robinette said in a statement.
Financial terms of the deal were not immediately available.
